description: This file defines a React functional component named ChatbotWidget that implements a floating chat assistant UI for recipe-related queries. It manages local state for messages, input, and UI toggles, and communicates with a backend /chatbot API to send and receive chat messages. The component includes UI controls for opening, closing, clearing, and sending messages, as well as auto-scrolling and user feedback via notifications.

methods.name: ChatbotWidget()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the chatbot interface with message management, user interaction handlers, and API integration.
